notes: μή τις is split rather than joined because the ASV writes two English words, one answering to each token; rule 59's joined unit is for a single word such as nothing.
μηδένα is aligned to any under rule 69, which keeps the clause's negation on μή.
The supplied it will not be is added under rule 5: no source token in the projection licenses it, and rule 37 is ruled out because no neighbouring verse carries a licensing token.
Both τῆς tokens are unrepresented under rule 23, the ASV giving sin and perdition no determiner, so the case preposition of stays with each noun.
